rows.behavior: release-tag.yml reads the before commit's version from apm/apm.yml alone (a release.py subcommand or flag that does not require the root apm.yml to agree), so a before commit whose root apm.yml is missing or differs still gives its version, and compare can report lowered; only a before commit with no readable apm/apm.yml version gives an empty OLD.
rows.fails_when: the before read still uses `current || true`, a before commit with a differing root apm.yml gives an empty OLD, or a lowered version on such a commit is not refused
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_release.py tests/scripts/test_workflows.py -k before -q

rows.behavior: The full suite and every tier pass.
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
